fit.description:
Renderer 17, in the shell: a navigation row kept to one line in the room its parent box gives it (the
parent's width, so give the row a parent whose width does not follow it). The renderer measures every
child of the row, a repeat's items one by one; the destinations (children pressing home, library or live)
that do not fit beside the others leave from the row's end, last first, and Home always stays. Then
`nav.more` holds (draw a More control in the row on it: it is measured as if shown), `dest.more` holds for
each library left out, `nav.liveMore` for Live TV, and `nav.moreOn` while the current section is one of them.

pager.description:
A row's pager (inside a home row): this box scrolls sideways; `pageNext`/`pagePrev {row.id}` move it by
max(200, width - 2 x inset - peek) px, and `pager.*` say whether it overflows and is at an end.

readingStop.description:
Renderer 18: on TV this box, which presses nothing, still takes focus (wearing the focus ring) so the
remote reaches it and a screen reader reads it as one passage, by its `label` or else its text: a menu's
About line below its last control. Elsewhere it is an ordinary box (its text selectable on the web).

SurfaceContext.description:
The host context a surface document reads as `{context.<name>}`. Sent to Ether as p.event, p.channel,
p.title, p.kind and p.alert.ref only; chrome, pictureTime and delayed stay on the client.

pictureTime.description: Wall-clock time of the frame on screen (behind live when timeshifted).

SurfaceContribution.description:
A surface a client may show (bootstrap `surfaces`, filtered, capped and ordered by Ether). `when` is
evaluated by Vela locally. Routes: GET /surfaces/{id}/document, GET /surfaces/{id}/data?p.event=&p.channel=
&p.title=&p.kind=&p.alert.ref=&tz= (404: draw nothing), POST /surfaces/{id}/actions/{action}.
`id` is "<pluginShort>.<id>".

setting.description:
A player-menu switch (required on every player overlay). `enabled` is the viewer's remembered
choice; PUT /surfaces/{id}/setting {enabled} (204) changes it, per viewer.

visibility.description: playerOverlay only: always shown, only with the chrome, or a viewer switch in the player menu.

SurfaceRow.description:
A row a plugin's homeRow surface fills, a stub in page order among the rows (bootstrap, /rows,
a library's rows tab): no items, receiptToken or continuation. The id is opaque (never parse it):
`plugin`, `surface` (the wire id, as bootstrap `surfaces` lists it) and `library` say what it is.
Sent only to a client with X-Vela-Screen-Renderer, for a surface published for the viewer.
